config.hiresshot.title: HiResShot Configuration
config.hiresshot.multiplier.tooltip:
Scale factor based on window size.
Range: 2 - 32.
(Only used when 'Use Custom Resolution' is OFF)
config.hiresshot.hideGui.tooltip: Whether to hide HUD, chat, and crosshair during capture.
config.hiresshot.hidePlayer.tooltip:
Prevents the player model from rendering.
Useful to avoid self-shadows when using shaders.
config.hiresshot.warmupFrames.tooltip:
Frames to render before saving.
Higher values allow shaders (Auto-Exposure/TAA) to stabilize.
config.hiresshot.realTimeMode.tooltip:
True: Game continues running at high-res (Best for Shaders).
False: Freezes game to render instantly (Faster).
config.hiresshot.useCustomResolution.too: If enabled, overrides the multiplier with the specific Width/Height below.
